children: has partnered with the South Korea-based IT firm LG CNS to advance quantum use case identification, development and deployment in Asia, the companies announced today.

The collaboration will focus on applying D-Wave's annealing quantum computing technology to complex optimization challenges, with the goal of moving applications from proof of concept into production.

"To generate meaningful results from quantum computing in industrial settings, quantum technology must be supported by a deep understanding of industries and strong optimization capabilities," said Hyun Shin-Gyoon, CEO of LG CNS. "Through our collaboration with D-Wave Quantum, we will connect quantum computing to real-world customer problems and new business opportunities, accelerating the commercialization of related services."

"LG CNS understands both the optimization problems enterprises need to solve and the systems those solutions must work within," added D-Wave CEO Alan Baratz. "By combining that expertise with our technology, we intend to help enterprises in South Korea and beyond move from evaluating quantum computing to deploying applications that deliver measurable business value."
